passive.name: Icathian Surprise
passive.description: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.

primaryAbilities.name: Caustic Spittle
primaryAbilities.description: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Kog'Maw gains {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed.

Active: Kog'Maw vomits a corrosive projectile that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first enemy hit and shreds {{ shredamount }}% Armor and Magic Resist for {{ shredduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
primaryAbilities.description: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Kog'Maw gains {{ range }} Attack Range and his Attacks deal an additional <magicDamage>{{ totalhealthdamage }} max Health magic damage</magicDamage> %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Void Ooze
primaryAbilities.description: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Kog'Maw spits bile, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and leaving a trail of ooze for {{ trailduration }} seconds. Enemies in the ooze are <status>Slowed</status> by {{ slowamount }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Living Artillery
primaryAbilities.description: Kog'Maw fires an artillery shell at a great distance dealing magic damage (increased significantly on low health enemies) and revealing non-stealthed targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Kog'Maw shoots acid at an area, dealing {{ basedamagecalc }} plus {{ tooltipmissinghealthdamageamp }}% per 1% missing Health magic damage and revealing enemies hit for 2 seconds. Enemies below 40% Health instead take {{ maxdamagecalc }} magic damage.

Subsequent shots within {{ manacostduration }} seconds cost an additional {{ basecost }} Mana (max: {{ manacostcap }} Mana).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
